topic: Arrested? Your next 24 hours — a timeline on a 24-hour clock: hour 0 when police actually hold you (Art. 22(2), BNSS s.58; Sujit Das, SC 5 Nov 2026); at the arrest: memo (s.36), grounds (s.47), family told (s.48); at the station: medical (s.53), lawyer (s.38), bail in a bailable offence (s.47(2), s.478); written grounds at least 2 h before remand (Mihir Rajesh Shah, SC 2025); Magistrate within 24 h, travel excluded: release, bail or custody (s.187); free legal aid (LSA Act s.12(g)); one-minute check: emergency contact + NALSA 15100
audience: Everyday families and young people (primary); law students
